Package index

Validation utilities

Pre-flight checks for BAMs, reference files, and the GATK executable.

CYAN_check_bam()
Validate a BAM file
CYAN_check_references()
Validate reference files
CYAN_resolve_gatk()
Resolve the GATK executable path

RNA editing detection

RNA editing (e.g. A-to-I) detection via REDItools2.

CYAN_run_reditools()
Run REDItools2 RNA editing detection
CYAN_run_reditools_batch()
Run REDItools2 on multiple samples

Print methods

S3 print methods for the result objects CYAN’s functions return.

print(<cyan_batch_result>)
Print method for cyan_batch_result
print(<cyan_editing_result>)
Print method for cyan_editing_result
